purpose: legislators:PK:Azad Jammu and Kashmir:general seats for constituencies LA-1 to LA-45
query: List the CURRENT members of the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly (Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Pakistan) holding the general seats for constituencies LA-1 to LA-45, as of 2026-11-15. For each member give full name, constituency code and name (for constituency seats), seat type (general, women_reserved, minority_reserved, other_reserved), party name and acronym, term start, whether the seat was won in a by-election, and source URLs that list this person as a member for this seat. Account for by-elections, deaths, resignations and disqualifications since the general election; omit vacant seats.
text: As of 15 November 2026, 38 of the 45 general constituencies had members. LA-18 through LA-24 are omitted because their 2026 polls remained postponed and the Assembly’s member list shows no officeholders. The listed members took office with the new Assembly on 24 August 2026; none won a by-election. The Election Commission’s publicly accessible notification archive did not provide the 2026 returned-candidate notices, so membership and party details follow the Assembly’s official 2026 list, supplemented by contemporary election reporting.
